title: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic
prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic lifestyle portrait of a beautiful young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, seated inside a dimly lit, contemporary minimalist café. Capture the scene in a vertical, intimate medium-close composition, framing her from the top of her head to her lower torso, with her upper body occupying most of the foreground.

She has a delicate oval-shaped face, a softly tapered chin, a petite straight nose, naturally full rose-pink lips, and smooth, fair skin with warm peach undertones. Her expressive dark brown almond-shaped eyes are accentuated by subtle eyeliner, naturally curled eyelashes, and softly defined eyebrows. Her face is shown in an elegant three-quarter-to-side profile as she turns her head toward the right side of the frame, gazing thoughtfully at something outside the camera's view. Her expression is calm, slightly wistful, and introspective, with relaxed lips and a composed demeanor.

Her long, thick, silky jet-black hair is styled in a high ponytail secured near the crown of her head, cascading in loose, slightly tousled waves over her left shoulder and down across her chest. Soft, wispy eyebrow-length bangs frame her forehead, while delicate face-framing strands fall naturally along her cheeks and neck.

Her figure is feminine and naturally curvaceous, with a full bust, a defined waist, and softly rounded shoulders. She wears a fitted ivory-white ribbed camisole featuring very thin spaghetti straps, a low, rounded scoop neckline, and a snug, subtly textured fabric that follows her natural silhouette. A loose, oversized charcoal-gray cardigan is draped casually off both shoulders, resting around her upper arms and elbows, revealing her shoulders and collarbones. A delicate gold necklace with a tiny pendant rests at the base of her neck, accompanied by a small, understated ear accessory.

She sits upright yet relaxed, her torso angled slightly toward the camera while her head turns distinctly to her left, toward the right edge of the image. Her arms remain low and relaxed beneath the loose cardigan, creating a natural, unposed café portrait.

Behind her, a tall, brightly illuminated frosted-glass doorway occupies the left background, producing strong diffused backlighting and a gentle luminous rim around her ponytail and shoulders. Dark charcoal walls, wooden café tables, black metal chairs, and understated industrial furnishings fill the shadowy right background. A warm wooden tabletop runs along the bottom foreground.

Use soft natural window light mixed with muted amber interior illumination, realistic skin pores, gentle shadows, subtle film grain, cinematic contrast, subdued brown-and-charcoal color grading, and authentic photographic texture. Shoot with a full-frame camera, 50mm portrait lens, f/1.8 aperture, shallow depth of field, natural anatomical proportions, and softly blurred environmental details. Preserve an intimate, candid editorial aesthetic without artificial skin smoothing, excessive retouching, or exaggerated body proportions. Aspect ratio 9:16.
